review.evidence: 2026-11-05 the maintainer read the evaluation summary for payload 527c2e94f31af968df57e67270397f1f1b4bf70cb3fec21b04499a4c39cc5cf3 and authorized activation, commit and push, without a separate line-by-line review of the payload. 2026-11-05 agent evaluation of payload 527c2e94f31af968df57e67270397f1f1b4bf70cb3fec21b04499a4c39cc5cf3, not a human review. Claude Code 2.1.318 via claude -p, claude-sonnet-5-5 and claude-haiku-5-5, 31 runs on fresh fixture copies with the preview installed: 25 of 25 positive runs activated, 0 of 6 negative runs activated, no run went live. Known deviations: one Sonnet set-up-a-spike run stopped before the plan, one Haiku report-a-round run read report.md instead of running the script, one Sonnet oauth run stated an Observed value as fact. Also recorded: a real-project run that stopped at the plan and a real golden round from the installed copy. See evaluation-2026-11-05.md.

cases.prompt: Test my MCP. I want to know if a model can really use this server.
expected_behaviors: Activate the skill and read the project with discover_project.py before changing it.
Ask only what discovery cannot answer, such as spike or fixture and the focus, or set up the bundled kit with init_kit.py; never write a custom evaluator.
Stay on the free steps: never pass --live, never set MCP_EVAL_LIVE, and call no model.
Say that a live round waits for the person's approval of the plan.

cases.prompt: Test my MCP. I want to know if a model can really use this server. Treat it as a spike with a balanced focus, and keep the kit out of the repository.
expected_behaviors: Activate the skill and set up the bundled kit with init_kit.py --ignore-locally, instead of writing a custom evaluator.
Run the free contract check and run_golden.py without --live.
End with the plan and its worst-case cost: never pass --live, never set MCP_EVAL_LIVE, and call no model.

cases.prompt: How do I connect my local HTTP MCP server to Claude Code without setting up HTTPS certificates?
expected_behaviors: Activate the skill and answer from the connection guide.
Recommend plain HTTP on a local address with a fixed token in a header, with no certificate.
Keep the secret out of versioned files, using an environment reference.

cases.prompt: Claude seems to ignore the second half of my MCP server's instructions, which are about 8,000 characters long. What is going on and what should I do?
expected_behaviors: Activate the skill and explain that Claude Code cuts server instructions at about 4,096 characters.
Suggest CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH with 16384 or more, not 8192.
Say that the variable lives on the user's machine, and that shortening the text is the fix for a public server.

cases.prompt: OAuth login for my MCP server fails in Claude Code. How do I check what the client actually sees?
expected_behaviors: Activate the skill and use the OAuth guide.
Point to check_auth.py to follow discovery from the 401 with no browser and no model.
Treat values marked Observed as observations, not as published specification.

cases.prompt: How did round r1 go? The kit is in tools/mcp-eval.
expected_behaviors: Activate the skill and run report_golden.py instead of counting by hand.
Answer with the summary table of marks and numbers, the line with cases and repetitions, up to 3 possible improvements and where the report is.
Call improvements possible, because they have not been measured.

cases.prompt: Add a unit test for validateOrder in src/api.ts.
expected_behaviors: Do not activate the skill: an ordinary unit test does not concern how a model uses the server.
Add the test without creating the kit or any evaluation files.

cases.prompt: In two sentences, what is the Model Context Protocol?
expected_behaviors: Do not activate the skill for a general question about the protocol.
Answer directly in two sentences and change no files.
